title: Environmental Demography: reproduce life-history and aridity association with demographic buffering
question: Do life-history axes (LHPC) and climate axes (ClimPC) predict the cumulative stochastic elasticity of variance across 121 populations, as the manuscript reports?
hypothesis: LHPC.1 (survival-reproduction trade-off axis) has a significant association with log cumulative SigElas; ClimPC terms add explanatory power. Non-phylogenetic mixed model is a simplification of the authors' MCMCglmm.
method: linear mixed model (species random intercept) vs LH-only vs null; AIC; medicinal subset
finding: Not replicated for life history: LH1 p=0.34 in a non-phylogenetic mixed model. Climate axes are associated (ClimPC1 p=0.0001, ClimPC2 p=0.0007; AIC 506 -> 486). The authors' phylogenetic MCMCglmm on separate vital-rate elasticities may detect what this simplification misses; treated as contextual, not used for harvest decisions.

result.note: Overlaps COMPADRE; separate analysis, not independent confirmation of COMPADRE harvest results.
